title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-and-version-bump-v1.120.0
author: Ethan Morris
description: Unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and bump SDK versions to v1.120.0. Motivation: multiple downstream repos and customers reported inconsistent retry behavior and streaming ergonomics between SDKs which caused integration surprises during rollouts. This PR standardizes the auth provider interface, centralizes retry logic with a shared backoff policy, harmonizes streaming callback/iterator ergonomics, fixes parity bugs uncovered by the integration test matrix, and updates package versions and changelogs. Work included coordinated changes across sdk-python, sdk-typescript, and sdk-go plus docs and changelogs. Checklist: 1) Unify auth provider interface and token refresh hooks across SDKs; 2) Implement consistent retry wrapper with idempotency hooks and jittered exponential backoff; 3) Improve streaming API ergonomics (Python: async iterator + sync iter convenience, TS: ReadableStream wrapper, Go: channel/iterator helper); 4) Fix parity gaps (stream end sentinel, reconnect semantics, error propagation); 5) Run cross-SDK e2e matrix and update changelogs and versions; 6) Add migration notes and examples. Impact: backward-compatible in most cases; a small opt-in change for advanced custom auth providers (see migration notes).
commits: feat(common): introduce sdk-auth interface and shared retry/backoff implementation
refactor(python): adapt SDK to new auth interface and expose async iterator convenience wrapper
feat(typescript): add readable-stream wrapper and retry middleware parity with python
fix(go): close stream sentinel handling and propagate stream errors consistently
docs: update migration guide and changelogs for v1.120.0
chore: bump versions to v1.120.0 across SDKs
review_comments: Maya Chen: Please add a short note in the migration guide about custom AuthProvider implementations; without it some users saw infinite refresh loops.
Ethan Morris (author): Added migration section and example implementation for custom providers. Also added an opt-in compatibility shim in python for legacy providers.
Lucas Fernandez: The TypeScript streaming wrapper is ergonomic but we need to ensure backpressure is preserved when consumers are slow. Can we add a test?
Ethan Morris (author): Added a backpressure unit test and adjusted buffer behavior to match Node stream semantics.
Priya Patel: Go change LGTM after minor comment about closing the underlying connection on context cancel - otherwise leak risk.
Ethan Morris (author): Fixed context cancel handling and added a short integration test exercising cancellation paths.
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth provider API and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go; improve streaming ergonomics and error semantics; fix parity bugs in stream sentinel and reconnect logic; bump SDK versions to v1.120.0. Migration: see docs/sdk-migration-auth-retries.md for notes on custom AuthProvider changes and compatibility shim.
